title: Lanes start at low effort and escalate to high only after a red check
body:
Source: operator rss digest 2026-11-17, Addy Osmani Claude playbook (https://x.com/addyosmani/status/2121732470118965298): Opus low effort with failures rerun at high reached ~97%% at $0.17/task vs 95.3%% at $0.29 all-high on a SWE-bench Pro subset.
Outcome: krn lane start runs the lane at low effort; a red Check (ship exit 74) reruns the fix turn at high; krn ledger prints first-push-green share and cost per PR for 10 lanes under the policy vs the 10 before it.
Proof: the ledger report file under .krn/runs/research/ lists both arms with first-push-green and cost per PR.
